track.statsHint: These count the track as it stands right now. The timeline below follows the dates you pick.
track.statsPartial: Only part of the workspace is loaded, so these counts describe what is in view.
track.tagsHint: How this window splits across the track's tags. An item carrying two tags is counted under both, so the rows do not add up to the total.
track.tagsEmpty: Nothing in this window carries a tag.
track.tagsEmptyHint: An admin can suggest tags for a track from Settings, then Tracks.
track.historyScope: Open a track on the map to read what happened in it.
track.emptyHint: Widen the dates, or clear the search.
track.emptyTrack: Nothing has been filed here yet
track.emptyTrackHint: Capture something and choose this track, and it shows up here.
track.errLoad: This track's timeline could not be loaded.
track.truncated: This window holds more events than can load at once, so the oldest are missing. Narrow the dates.
